requirements.contract: Organizer_Stage2_Technical_Specification_2.2/openapi/openapi.yaml schema CalendarEvent (id, organizationId, version, projectId, title, description, eventDate, isAllDay, startAtUtc, endAtUtc, timeZone, status, userAttendees, contactAttendees) must be persistable; the migrator catalog must stay executable so a fresh PostgreSQL 16 database becomes Ready after the three migrations are applied.
requirements.rules: The 002 identity/audit migration must apply on a real PostgreSQL 16 instance, therefore its permission code regex must contain a real escape backslash (the pre-existing '\' double escape made the whole migration fail inside its transaction and blocked every later migration). Calendar persistence follows the approved foundation conventions: organization-scoped surrogate PKs (id) with a UNIQUE (organization_id, id) pair used by composite FKs, soft-delete lifecycle columns, optimistic concurrency via version, feature tables keyed (event_id, position) in stored attendee order, CHECK constraints, no hard deletes. Bootstrap must keep the same checksum/row-count semantics and the same write set; only statement shape may change.
